correctness.rationale: For any finite reversible generator, orthogonal eigenspace projections give a real signed exponential sum with at most n-1 distinct nonzero exponents. A Rolle induction yields at most n-2 isolated crossings, with the identically zero case separated. The explicit Ehrenfest generating identity proves eigenvalues -2j and normalized Krawtchouk orthogonality. Splitting each desired crossing polynomial coefficient into positive/negative squared mode amplitudes and choosing a sufficiently small epsilon proves full-support laws and the exact prescribed-time factorization for every n. The four-state spin witness has exact positive rational laws, elementary Walsh eigenvalues, and two simple polynomial roots. Package verifier passed exact identities and 9 independent semigroup comparisons.

value.rationale: This is a sharp, natural finite-state observability classification. It fixes the minimum system size for two Pearson-distance rank reversals at four and gives a controllable exact calendar of n-2 reversals for all larger n on a canonical physical urn at unchanged rates, despite monotonic decay of both distances and detailed balance. It distinguishes quadratic metrics from known relative-entropy crossings and provides reproducible spin-preparation benchmarks. It does not assert thermal-Gibbs Mpemba effects, and no new Chebyshev theorem is claimed.
